description: Open times with a pro (id from find_pros_to_book, or their booking handle) for a service, on "today", "tomorrow", "week", a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a range. Times are in the pro's local time zone. No ShearQuery account needed.

pro_id.description: The pro id from find_pros_to_book, or the pro's booking handle (e.g. "marcus-cuts").

service.description: The service name as find_pros_to_book lists it (e.g. "Haircut"), or its id. Part of the name works if only one service matches.

when.description: "today", "tomorrow", "week", a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a range. Default "week".

name: pro_open_times
title: Open times with a barber or stylist
